findings.detail: Tool "get_family_benefits" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_retail_prices, get_broker_fees, check_knf_warnings, get_savings_bond_sales, get_eu_public_debt · Private data: get_investment_funds, get_vehicle_registrations, get_ev_charging, get_tax_rulings, get_compliance_calendar, get_business_guide · Public sink: get_business_registrations, get_vehicle_registrations, get_ev_charging_prices, get_fixed_cost_burden, get_municipal_budget, get_finwire_index, get_lead_forecasts, get_credit_judgments, get_regional_data, get_family_benefits, get_pit_settlement_stats, get_rkm_price_limits, get_savings_bond_sales, get_eu_fuel_prices, get_eu_living_conditions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_retail_prices, get_broker_fees, check_knf_warnings, get_savings_bond_sales, get_eu_public_debt · Private data: get_investment_funds, get_vehicle_registrations, get_ev_charging, get_tax_rulings, get_compliance_calendar, get_business_guide · Public sink: get_business_registrations, get_vehicle_registrations, get_ev_charging_prices, get_fixed_cost_burden, get_municipal_budget, get_finwire_index, get_lead_forecasts, get_credit_judgments, get_regional_data, get_family_benefits, get_pit_settlement_stats, get_rkm_price_limits, get_savings_bond_sales, get_eu_fuel_prices, get_eu_living_conditions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
